description: Phase 8: Add 'Preview on Telegram' button to the admin dashboard ArtistDetailPage, with a new API endpoint and frontend wiring.

steps.task: Add API endpoint `POST /api/artists/:id/telegram-preview` in handlers/api.rs. Auth-guarded (same as other artist endpoints). Flow: (1) Load artist by ID. (2) Find the artist's assigned show via `SELECT show_id FROM artist_show_assignments WHERE artist_id = ?`. (3) Check artist has instagram_caption (return 400 if missing). (4) Call `telegram_notify::send_artist_instagram_preview(state, &artist)`. (5) Return JSON `{ "success": true }` on success or appropriate error.

decisions: Reuse the same send_artist_instagram_preview function used by the scheduler and Telegram commands
Require instagram_caption to exist before sending preview
learnings: Auth pattern: HeaderMap extraction + verify_auth() function
Route registration is in main.rs Router builder

steps.task: Register the new route in main.rs Router: `.route("/api/artists/:id/telegram-preview", post(api::api_send_artist_telegram_preview))`.

knowledge.notes: Place next to the existing artist Instagram route

steps.task: Add `sendTelegramPreview` method to `artistsApi` in source/frontend/src/admin/api/index.ts: `sendTelegramPreview: (id: number) => api.post(`/artists/${id}/telegram-preview`)`. Place it alongside the existing postToInstagram method.

learnings: Existing pattern: postToInstagram: (id, force, account) => api.post(`/artists/${id}/instagram`, ...)

steps.task: Add '📱 Preview on Telegram' button to ArtistDetailPage.vue. Location: near the Instagram preview section, around the existing Instagram buttons (~line 850-955). Add: (1) A `sendingTelegramPreview` ref(false) for loading state. (2) A `sendTelegramPreview()` async function that calls `artistsApi.sendTelegramPreview(artist.id)`, shows flash success/error, and sets loading state. (3) A BaseButton in the template: `<BaseButton @click="sendTelegramPreview" :disabled="sendingTelegramPreview" :loading="sendingTelegramPreview">📱 Preview on Telegram</BaseButton>`. Disable the button if no instagram_caption exists (same condition as Instagram preview). Show the button only when the artist has an instagram_caption.

decisions: Disable when no caption exists or when sending is in progress
Flash notification for success/failure using useFlash composable
learnings: useFlash composable provides flash() for success/error toasts
knowledge.notes: Consider placing the button in the Instagram preview modal footer, or as a standalone button outside the modal

steps.task: Run `cargo check` from source/backend/ to verify the backend compiles. Fix any errors.
